tool_loop.title: Tool-call loop

fabricated_data.title: Fabricated data

wrong_refusal.title: Unwarranted refusal

goal_drift.title: Silent goal drift

task_incomplete.title: Task not completed

tool_loop.title: Tool-call loop

fabricated_data.title: Fabricated data

wrong_refusal.title: Unwarranted refusal

schema_violation.title: Tool schema violation
schema_violation.remediation: Give the model the schema verbatim; validate before dispatch.
